dataset.notes: Binary sentiment on test reviews with at least 1,000 whitespace-separated words. Full original text, without truncation or padding; word counts are not token counts. Context-limit rejections are request failures, not incorrect predictions. A length-selected stress test, not a representative IMDb accuracy benchmark. Training overlap is possible. Dataset license is 'other'; review the source terms.
